sources.fullCitation: Tanzorchester J. Geiger, refrain sung by Hans Rotter. “Du bist verrückt, mein Schatz, du denkst an Liebe.” Lied und foxtrot; label credits music and text to Fritz Rotter and Dr. B. Kaper. Novaphon Electro Record B 4051, made in Austria, n.d.; matrix 2647 identified in Discographie der österreichischen Populärmusik. Flexible disc, Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv; filmed-label transfer on YouTube.
sources.title: Du bist verrückt, mein Schatz, du denkst an Liebe — Novaphon Electro Record B Nr. 4051
sources.creator: Tanzorchester J. Geiger, Refraingesang: Hans Rotter
sources.researchNote: Discographie der österreichischen Populärmusik, pp. 53–54, lists “Du bist verückt mein Schatz, denn du denkst ...”, matrix 2647, on Novaphon 4051 under “Tanzorchester J. Geiger” and the recording-group heading “Wien, 1932”. The structured date follows that year-level recording chronology, not a separately documented issue date. It supersedes the uploader’s approximate 1931 issue dating; no month or day is inferred. The matrix is only partly legible in the filmed label, so 2647 is identified from the discography rather than presented as a complete label reading. The uploader’s expansion of J. Geiger to Isy Geiger is not silently substituted for the label wording. The examined label does not name Wiener Boheme-Verlag; that publisher credit rests on a separate printed source.
